Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(10);
Begin
 temp_buffer := :s_consignee_id;
 select name into :s_cons_name from consignee
 where consignee_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select consignee_id, name into
 :s_consignee_id, :s_cons_name
 from consignee
 where customer_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select consignee_id, name into
 :s_consignee_id, :s_cons_name
 from consignee
 where upper(name) like
 (temp_buffer || '%')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 end;
 when others then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select process_hours, class_desc
 into :s_process_hours, :s_order_class_desc
 from vserv_order_classES where order_class=:order_class
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 select code_desc into :s_status_desc from vserv_order_status
 where code=:order_status;
 exception when others then null;
END;
if :order_status in ('PK', 'SH', 'DL','CL') then
begin
 select to_char(trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,packed_date))-:insert_date)*24))||':'||
 lpad(to_char(abs(round((((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,packed_date))-:insert_date)*24)-
 trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,packed_date))-:insert_date)*24))*60,0))),2,'00'),
 decode(least(:s_process_hours, (max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,packed_date))-:insert_date)*24),
 :s_process_hours, '*', null)
 into :s_pack_time, :s_pack from boxes where
 box_id in (select box_id from pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp
 where ps.order_no=:order_no
 and ps.pick_slip_id=psp.pick_slip_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception when no_data_found then
 message('error in selecting Packed date');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
end;
end if;

if :order_status in ('SH', 'DL','CL') then
begin
 select to_char(trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24))||':'||
 lpad(to_char(abs(round((((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24)-
 trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24))*60,0))),2,'00'),
 to_char(trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24))||':'||
 lpad(to_char(abs(round((((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24)-
 trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24))*60,0))),2,'00'),
 decode(max(receipt_date), null, null,
 to_char(trunc((max(receipt_date)-:insert_date)*24))||':'
 ||lpad(to_char(abs(round((((max(receipt_date)-:insert_date)*24)-
 trunc((max(receipt_date)-:insert_date)*24))*60,0))),2,'00')),
 decode(least(:s_process_hours,(max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date))-:insert_date)*24),
 :s_process_hours, '*', null),
 decode(least(:s_process_hours,(max(receipt_date)-:insert_date)*24),
 :s_process_hours, '*', null)
 into :order_age, :s_ship_time, :s_dely_time, :s_ship, :s_dely
 from shipments where
 shipment_no in (select shipment_no from boxes bx, pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp
 where psp.box_id=bx.box_id and ps.order_no=:order_no
 and ps.pick_slip_id=psp.pick_slip_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
and bx.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
)
and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
/*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception when no_data_found then
 message('error in selecting shipment date');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
end;
else
 select to_char(trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate))-:insert_date)*24))||':'||
 lpad(to_char(abs(round((((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate))-:insert_date)*24) -
 trunc((max(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate))-:insert_date)*24))*60,0))),2,'00')
 into :order_age from dual;
end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;

Trigger.Name: CALCULATE_TOTAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 select count(*) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_total_orders from orders
 where ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) or (insert_date between
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date+.9999,sysdate)))
 and consignee_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_consignee_id and
 (:ctrl_blk_1.s_order_class is null
 or order_class=:ctrl_blk_1.s_order_class)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 select count(*) into :s_tot_on_time_ship from orders
 where
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exists
 (select 'x' from boxes bo, pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp, shipments sh, vserv_order_classes vs
 where psp.box_id=bo.box_id and bo.shipment_no=sh.shipment_no
 and ps.pick_slip_id=psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.order_no=orders.order_no
 and orders.order_class=vs.order_class
 and process_hours >= (sh.shipment_date-orders.insert_date)*24
 and orders.consignee_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_consignee_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and bo.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sh.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and vs.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 )
 and ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) or (insert_date between
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date+.9999,sysdate)))
 and (order_class=:ctrl_blk_1.s_order_class
 or :ctrl_blk_1.s_order_class is null)
 ;
 if nvl(:s_total_orders,0)>0 then
 :s_percent_on_time:=round(100*:s_tot_on_time_ship/:s_total_orders,2);
 end if;
 exception when no_data_found then null;
 when others then null;
end;
